name: Feature grid
summary: Heading and intro above a ruled grid of numbered feature notes. Three, two, or one column by width.
accessibility: Features are a list, so screen readers announce the count.
Headings step from h2 to h3. Put the grid under a page that already has an h1.

features.title: Imports
features.body: Bring in CSV or connect a spreadsheet.

features.title: Checks
features.body: Flags rows that don't match the schema.

features.title: Sync
features.body: Pushes clean rows back on a schedule.
